author: unknown
content:
Are there any alternatives to shadowplay's instant replay feature?
I have had an NVIDIA card for the last 6+ years and shadowplay has been the greatest application I have ever used. Countless clips of dumb stuff with friends or once in a lifetime moments that I can look back on years later.

With the massive GPU shortage I decided to get an AMD card, and it will really suck letting go of shadowplay. I know I can record the gameplay with OBS, but the beauty of shadowplay was the ability to only clip the last \[x\] minutes to cut down wasted space and time going through it all.

PlaysTV is one that I did actually try before, but it was super finicky when I used it. If there are no others i'll probably go for it, but I am hoping there are some better options out there.
